title: Submission sidecar
description: submission/<object_id>.sidecar.json (93 §3.9, 97 §2.5): never part of the answer. It is a RunManifest scoped to exactly one object — input_manifest_hash, config_hash (+ stage_config_hashes), versions, per-file status and page_basis, the missing-on-disk list, timings and, for the frozen hidden run, freeze_tag (the inspector-score hidden guard reads it). `files` lists only that object's files. Owner: AG-04 (writer), AG-00 (contract).
